page_title: LEV 1-1 RSO | Levante v Real Sociedad 20/12/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+7' A corner kick by Levante is thwarted by the well prepared Alex Remiro (Real Sociedad).

90+6' Dela (Levante) gets to the ball from the resulting corner and tries his luck with a shot, but one of the defenders steps in to block the effort. Levante force a corner. They send men into the box.
90+6' Levante force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
90+4' 1 - 1 Goal! Dela (Levante) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Alex Remiro into the bottom left corner.
90+4' Dela (Levante) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
90+3' Arkaitz Mariezkurrena (Real Sociedad) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent. The referee's verdict is crystal clear. A penalty is awarded to Levante!
90+2' Levante can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
90+1' Lander Astiazaran (Real Sociedad) volleys the ball on the edge of the box after a rebound. It's a great effort and has Mathew Ryan scrambling, but it flies just over the bar.
90+1' Real Sociedad have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
90+1' Ion Ansotegi decides to make a substitution. Mikel Oyarzabal will be replaced by Lander Astiazaran (Real Sociedad).
90+1' That will be all from Takefusa Kubo who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Arkaitz Mariezkurrena (Real Sociedad).
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
88' Real Sociedad failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
88' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Real Sociedad comes to nothing.
87' Dela (Levante) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Guillermo Cuadra no option but to blow his whistle.
85' Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) finds himself unmarked on the edge of the box, but he drags his shot just wide of the right post.
84' Manu Sanchez (Levante) will miss the next game because of that yellow card.
84' Guillermo Cuadra shows a yellow card to Manu Sanchez (Levante) for his blatant foul.
83' Ion Ansotegi is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Pablo Marin (Real Sociedad) suffers an injury and Carlos Soler comes on.
82' Alvaro Del Moral has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Oriol Rey (Levante) replacing Unai Vencedor.
82' Today's match ends for Ivan Romero who will be replaced by Iker Losada (Levante).
79' The corner is swung in but Real Sociedad can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

79' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the underside of the crossbar is, however, superbly saved by Mathew Ryan!
78' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 8:13.
75' Real Sociedad can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
74' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Dela (Levante) was quite harsh and Guillermo Cuadra didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
74' Here is a change. Matias Moreno is going off and Alvaro Del Moral gives the last tactical orders to Alan Matturro (Levante).
74' Alvaro Del Moral has decided to make a change. Kareem Tunde replaces Jeremy Toljan (Levante).
73' It must be a yellow card. It is. Ivan Romero (Levante) receives the caution after an awful tackle.
71' Kervin Arriaga (Levante) has tested the patience of referee Guillermo Cuadra and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
70' Ion Ansotegi prepares a substitution. Luka Sucic is replaced by Arsen Zakharyan (Real Sociedad).
70' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Goncalo Guedes leaves the pitch and Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) comes on.
70' Manu Sanchez (Levante) takes a first-time shot from the edge of the box, but his effort is well blocked by the defender.
69' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Carlos Alvarez (Levante), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
67' Matias Moreno (Levante) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
67' Alvaro Del Moral has decided to substitute Pablo Martinez Andres and he is replaced by Carlos Espi (Levante).
65' Matias Moreno (Levante) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
65' Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) whips in a cross from the corner, but Mathew Ryan is well positioned and punches the ball away.
64' The ball is cleared after Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Real Sociedad.
62' The ball possession is 44:56.

60' Victor Garcia (Levante) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it. The ball goes out of play and Real Sociedad will have a goal kick.
59' Pablo Martinez Andres (Levante) makes a run beyond the last defender, but he's offside.
58' Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
57' One of the players from Real Sociedad times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
56' Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
55' Pablo Martinez Andres (Levante) picks up a pass and fires a powerful long-range shot which goes painfully close to the left post.
53' Unai Vencedor (Levante) makes a bad challenge and receives a yellow card. The referee had no doubt.
51' Jon Gorrotxategi (Real Sociedad) will miss the next game.
51' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Jon Gorrotxategi (Real Sociedad) was quite harsh and Guillermo Cuadra didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
51' Jeremy Toljan (Levante) commits a rough challenge and Guillermo Cuadra blows his whistle for an infringement.
50' Levante enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
47' The resulting set piece from Levante is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
46' The second half has just started.
45+2' The match has reached half-time.

45+1' 0 - 1 Goncalo Guedes produces a beautiful lofted cross into the box, where Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) rises high to head the ball into the bottom left corner and beyond the goalkeeper. He makes it 0:1.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Lovely run from Ivan Romero (Levante). He finds himself one-on-one with the goalkeeper, lines up a shot, but the keeper boldly launches himself to intercept the ball.
44' Carlos Alvarez (Levante) had a good opportunity from long range. His shot was directed towards the middle of the goal, but Alex Remiro was alert and made a comfortable save.
42' Jon Gorrotxategi (Real Sociedad) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Guillermo Cuadra saw the whole situation.
40' Pablo Marin (Real Sociedad) takes a mid-range shot, but the ball sails high over the bar.
40' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Real Sociedad, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
39' Guillermo Cuadra blows for a foul after Ivan Romero (Levante) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball. Real Sociedad will take a free kick near the side line.
37' Igor Zubeldia (Real Sociedad) will miss the next game because of that yellow card.
37' Igor Zubeldia (Real Sociedad) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Guillermo Cuadra had an easy-decision to make.
37' Jon Martin (Real Sociedad) outbattles the defender to win the ball from the corner, but he can't quite control his header and sends it just over the bar.
37' The linesman makes the right call and Real Sociedad will have a corner.
36' Victor Garcia (Levante) sends a cross into the box, but Alex Remiro comes off his line to gather the ball.
35' Real Sociedad are ruled offside.
33' An attempted cross from Goncalo Guedes (Real Sociedad) is cleared.
32' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Levante.
30' Mathew Ryan blocks Pablo Marin (Real Sociedad)'s effort from the edge of the box.
30' Real Sociedad quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

30' Goncalo Guedes (Real Sociedad) unleashed a powerful long-range strike, but the ball was blocked by a defender on its way. The ball goes out of play and Real Sociedad have been awarded a corner kick.
29' Levante take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
28' Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
27' Aritz Elustondo (Real Sociedad) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Mathew Ryan, who smothers the ball.
24' Victor Garcia (Levante) receives a well-played pass inside the penalty area and shoots. His effort sails well wide of the right post.
23' Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) takes a short pass in his stride inside the box, but hits a poor shot at goal that goes well wide of the left post.
21' Guillermo Cuadra shows a yellow card to Pablo Martinez Andres (Levante) for his blatant foul.
18' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
18' Real Sociedad take a short corner kick.
16' Levante fail to score from a corner as Alex Remiro (Real Sociedad) leaps to collect the ball.

15' That's unlucky! Matias Moreno (Levante) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared. The referee signals a corner kick to Levante.
12' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Mathew Ryan intercepts the ball.
12' A cross from Goncalo Guedes (Real Sociedad) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
9' Rough tackle by Jeremy Toljan (Levante). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
7' Luka Sucic (Real Sociedad) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
6' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Levante, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
5' Jon Gorrotxategi (Real Sociedad) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Guillermo Cuadra has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
5' The referee blows his whistle as Pablo Marin (Real Sociedad) was too aggressive in his challenge.
4' Dangerous play by Kervin Arriaga (Levante). Guillermo Cuadra blows his whistle for a foul.
2' Victor Garcia (Levante) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out at last! Levante will take the kick-off.
Guillermo Cuadra will referee today's match.
